mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id AS roomId, buyer_company_id AS buyerCompanyId, seller_company_id AS sellerCompanyId, part_id AS partId, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice, contract_text AS contractText, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM contracts WHERE buyer_company_id = #{companyId} OR seller_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, room_id AS roomId, buyer_company_id AS buyerCompanyId, seller_company_id AS sellerCompanyId, part_id AS partId, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice, contract_text AS contractText, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM contracts WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contracts (room_id, buyer_company_id, seller_company_id, part_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price, contract_text, status) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{buyerCompanyId}, #{sellerCompanyId}, #{partId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{contractText}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE contracts SET contract_text = #{contractText} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE contracts SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
